formats.pattern: current AQI at site
formats.template: The current AQI at {StationName} is {AQI}, which is classified as {AQICategory}. The latest reading was recorded at {LastUpdated}.

formats.pattern: air quality category at site
formats.template: {StationName} is currently in the {AQICategory} category with an AQI of {AQI} as of {LastUpdated}.

formats.pattern: PM2.5 / CO2 / NO2 / O3 / CO reading at site
formats.template: The latest {ParameterName} reading at {StationName} is {ParameterValue} {UnitName} at {LastUpdated}.

formats.pattern: temperature and humidity at site
formats.template: At {LastUpdated}, {StationName} recorded a temperature of {Temperature} {TempUnit} and relative humidity of {Humidity}%.

formats.pattern: PM10 and PM2.5 / NO2 O3 CO at site
formats.template: At {LastUpdated}, {StationName} recorded {Param1} at {Value1} {Unit1} and {Param2} at {Value2} {Unit2}.

formats.pattern: is device active or inactive
formats.template: Device {DeviceName} is currently {Status}. Its last measured data was received at {LastMeasured}.

formats.pattern: when did device last send data
formats.template: Device {DeviceName} last sent measured data at {LastMeasured}.

formats.pattern: which devices are offline
formats.template: There are {OfflineCount} offline device(s). The offline devices are: {DeviceName} at {StationName} (last active: {LastActive}), ...

formats.pattern: which devices are installed at site
formats.template: {StationName} has {DeviceCount} registered device(s): {DeviceList}.

formats.pattern: how many devices are registered
formats.template: HAWAQM currently has {TotalDeviceCount} registered devices.

formats.pattern: how many devices are active
formats.template: {ActiveDeviceCount} devices are currently active out of {TotalDeviceCount} registered devices.

formats.pattern: how many sites are registered
formats.template: HAWAQM currently has {TotalSiteCount} registered sites.

formats.pattern: how many sites in Abudhabi AL Ain AlDhafra
formats.template: The current site distribution is Abudhabi: {AbuDhabiCount}, AL Ain: {AlAinCount}, and AlDhafra: {AlDhafraCount}.

formats.pattern: how many sites in each sector
formats.template: The current sector distribution is Public & Government School: {SchoolCount}, Residential: {ResidentialCount}, Commercial: {CommercialCount}, and Industrial: {IndustrialCount}.

formats.pattern: current AQI for Abudhabi / AL Ain / AlDhafra region
formats.template: The current overall AQI for the {RegionName} region is {AQI}, classified as {AQICategory} as of {LastUpdated}.

formats.pattern: current AQI values for all regions
formats.template: The current regional AQI values are Abudhabi: {AbuDhabiAQI} ({AbuDhabiLevel}), AL Ain: {AlAinAQI} ({AlAinLevel}), and AlDhafra: {AlDhafraAQI} ({AlDhafraLevel}).

formats.pattern: which site has highest AQI today
formats.template: The highest site AQI recorded today is {MaxAQI} at {StationName}, {RegionName}, at {LastUpdated}. The AQI category is {AQICategory}.

formats.pattern: which site has lowest AQI today
formats.template: The lowest site AQI recorded today is {MinAQI} at {StationName}, {RegionName}, at {LastUpdated}. The AQI category is {AQICategory}.

formats.pattern: show all sites in sector X in region Y
formats.template: There are {SiteCount} {SectorName} sites in {RegionName}. The sites are {SiteList}.

formats.pattern: AQI / PM2.5 / CO2 for device
formats.template: {DeviceName} — {ParameterName}: {ParameterValue} {UnitName} (Last measured: {LastMeasured}). AQI category if AQI: append category.

formats.pattern: reading / readings for device
schools with CO2 / AQI / PM2.5
formats.template: There are {Count} school site(s) with {ParameterName} data. {StationName} in {RegionName} has {ParameterName} at {ParameterValue} {UnitName} (last updated: {LastUpdated}).
